_how_to: KPI colour + email-alert thresholds in %. green_at = number turns green at or above this; red_below = number turns red (and the Dean gets an email, US-36) below this. 'default' is used for every program. To give one program its own values, add it under 'programs' by ProgramCode, e.g. "programs": {"MBA": {"on_time_rate": {"green_at": 35, "red_below": 25}}}
